gloss_en: Sadness/melancholy (atzvut) — the depressive spirit of dejection, worry, and black bile that stems from the kelipot and the Other Side, opposes joy (simchah), strengthens the imaginative faculty and blocks prophecy; includes the biblical 'itzavon' ("in sorrow shall you eat") sorrow of livelihood, which Likutey Moharan explicitly identifies with atzvut
